newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BW/IP raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BW/IP raised to buy.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities said on Tuesday it had raised its rating for BW/IP Inc to buy from accumulate.
-- The pumping company's earnings per share (EPS) "are estimated to grow 20 percent, both in 1996 and 1997," analyst Thomas Burns Jr wrote in a report.
-- Fourth quarter EPS "should show a 70 percent gain from the year-ago period. BW/IP's favorable order trends support our sales and earnings estimates.
-- "Recent years' EPS disappointments are over," Burns wrote, noting recent improvement of senior management.

-- "BW/IP is the leading factor in its custom pump markets. Its historical financial characteristics have been superior to its peer group. We believe the shares will sell at a premium to its peer group versus its current discount if our 1996 and 1997 operating forecasts are correct."
-- The company's shares rose 3/8 to 16-1/8 on Tuesday afternoon.
